people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.
translations.bsb: The first one came out red, covered with hair like a fur coat; so they named him Esau.
translations.kjv: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
translations.asv: And the first came forth red, all over like a hairy garment. And they called his name Esau.
